tour.1: These four figures are NCRB counts for 2024. Hover over or tap the underlined words under a figure to see exactly what it counts.
tour.2: The cases and protests of September 2026 are set out here, each with the outlet that reported it, followed by what the records say about Delhi, Bihar and India.
tour.3: Each stitch stands for 100 cases. Red crosses ended in a conviction, red slashes in an acquittal or discharge, and blue crosses were still waiting for a verdict at the end of 2024.
tour.4: This table follows each crime from the police station to the court, year by year, for India as a whole. Choose a crime with the buttons above it.
tour.5: Choose a crime and a year. Tap a state on the map or in the list to open its own figures further down the page.
tour.6: Every number on the site can be downloaded in Excel or CSV, with the NCRB table it came from and the section of law it falls under.
tip.cs: The share of cases police finished investigating in which they filed a charge-sheet, the formal accusation that sends a case to court.
tip.inv: Cases the police were still investigating on 31 December of that year.
tip.court: Cases sent for trial that year plus every case still waiting from earlier years.
tip.trials: Trials that ended that year in a conviction, an acquittal or a discharge.
tip.cr: Convictions as a share of the trials that ended that year. This is the measure NCRB itself uses.
tip.pend: Cases still waiting for a verdict on 31 December, including cases that reached court in earlier years.
tip.cp: Cases still pending at the end of the year as a share of all cases before the courts that year.
tip.rate: Cases recorded for every lakh (1,00,000) women, using the female population NCRB projects for that year.
tip.ipc: The Indian Penal Code (IPC) applied to offences before 1 July 2024. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) replaced it from that date.
tip.pocso: The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012. Most sexual offences against girls under 18 are booked under this law.
pr.delhi: In 2024 police in Delhi recorded {rape} rape cases and {pocso} cases of penetrative sexual assault of girls under POCSO. That is {rate} rapes for every lakh women in Delhi, against {india} for India.
pr.bihar: Police in Bihar recorded {rape} rape cases and {pocso} POCSO cases of penetrative sexual assault in 2024, or {rate} rapes for every lakh women. A low recorded rate can come from less crime or from less recording, and NCRB's figures cannot tell the two apart.
pr.india: Across India, {pend} of every 100 rape cases before the courts in 2024 were still waiting for a verdict at the end of the year, and {conv} of every 100 rape trials that ended that year ended in a conviction.
